ExtendStorage.description:
ExtendStorage declares that this Entity extends another entity's storage
by adding a new JSONB column (namespace-isolated) to the target table.

target:  "module/entity" of the base entity being extended
namespace:  unique identifier for this extension column (ext_{namespace})

Extension fields MUST NOT be required (required=true is rejected at validation).
Extension data is stored in a separate column ext_{namespace}, not in the base data JSONB.
This allows clean uninstall via DROP COLUMN without affecting base data.

FieldType.description: Data type for a field — determines storage class, renderer widget, and validation rules

FilterSpec.description:
FilterSpec is a generic filter declaration shared by every data kind that
lists records (Table, Kanban, Listing, ApprovalInbox, …). A filter is used
in one of two roles:
  - `filters`: a user-adjustable control rendered in the kind's UI. If
    `default` is set, the control is pre-seeded with that value (the user
    can still change or clear it).
  - `fixed_filters`: an immutable, server-side filter — always merged into
    the list request, never rendered as a control and not user-clearable.

The resolved value is sent to the list API as `field[op]=value`, so `op`
defaults to "eq" and follows the backend filter operator set.

all_label.description: For select filters: caption of the \"All\" (clear) option. Default \"(ALL)\".

default.description: Pre-set value for a user-adjustable filter. Supports \"today\" / \"today()\", resolved by the renderer as the server's current date.

op.description: Filter operator sent to the list API

show_all.description: For select filters: show the \"All\" (clear) option. Default true.

FormAction.description: FormAction is a custom action button on a form (Frontend §4).

FormField.description:
FormField configures a single field in a form.
YAML uses `field:` to reference the Entity field name; JSON serializes as
`name:` to match the TypeScript FormField interface.

FormRender.description: Render mode: modal (popup dialog), drawer (side panel), separate_page (full page)

FormRenderDecl.description:
FormRenderDecl is the design-time container declaration of a Form
(Frontend §1.6). YAML accepts both `render: separate_page` (shorthand) and
`render: { mode: separate_page }`; JSON always serializes the object form to
match the renderer contract (`spec.render.mode`).

mode.description: @schema {description: "Render mode: modal (popup dialog), drawer (side panel), separate_page (full page)", enum: ["modal", "drawer", "separate_page"]}

FormSubmit.description: FormSubmit configures the submit button and post-submit behavior.

ForwardDatePolicy.description:
ForwardDatePolicy controls how far forward a transaction_date can be set (§14a).
Default max_days_forward = 0 (no forward dating allowed).

GuardDecl.description:
GuardDecl is a condition that must be met for a transition.
YAML accepts either an inline expression string (canonical, Core §14)
or a map with explicit expression/message keys.

HookDecl.description:
HookDecl attaches handler code to an action's before/after/on_error point,
or an event's before_deliver/after_deliver point (Core Extended §8). A
reserved action's own Impl (Action.Impl) is equivalent to one hook scoped
to that action, running last in the before-phase — hooks: entries let
other modules/scripts attach additional code to the same points, by name
or via the "*" wildcard, with priority ordering (default 10; lower runs
first).

HookTiming.description: When the hook executes relative to the action/event

MenuItem.description:
MenuItem is one navigation entry, embedded in App.spec.menu or
Module.spec.menu (Core §4.4/§4.5) — there is no standalone kind: Menu.
Menu order follows array position — no separate `order` field.

Every item is exactly one of three shapes, enforced by the loader/resolver
(see internal/manifest), not by separate Go types:

  - Adopt node (Type == "module"): only Module set.
    Splices that Module's own Menu wholesale at this position. Level 1 only.
  - Group node (len(Children) > 0): Label + Children. Module/View/Route
    forbidden on the group itself — only its descendants carry Module.
  - Leaf node (no Children, Type != "module"): Label + Module + exactly one
    of View/Route. Level 3 leaves cannot have Children (3-level cap).

view.description: name of a registered View resource

spec.title: Entity Spec
spec.description: EntitySpec defines a stateful, persisted business data resource (Core §4.1).

display_field.description: field name used as display label for this entity in relation pickers & detail pages

lifecycle.description: explicit frontend lifecycle: two_step_autosave | two_step_manual | plain_crud (default derived from actions)

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Service Spec
spec.description: ServiceSpec defines a stateless, pure computation resource (Core §4.2).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Config Spec
spec.description:
ConfigSpec defines runtime configuration values (Core §4.5, §10).
Keys are structured — each key declares its type, default value, and
whether it is a secret (never inlined in YAML, resolved per environment).
Scripts read values via ctx.config.get("key").

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Migration Spec
spec.description:
MigrationSpec defines a custom DDL migration (01-core-basic.md §4).
Only DDL statements are allowed — DML is rejected at runtime.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Subscription Spec
spec.description:
SubscriptionSpec subscribes to another resource's events (Core §4.6, Ref D35,
02-core-extended.md §3).

Tier 1 (Core, outbox): Events + Handler only.
Tier 2 (Streaming): adds store, retention, position, max_retry, dead_letter,
filter, transform, and explicit delivery channel.

filter.description: Tier 2: Starlark filter over event payload

transform.description: Tier 2: Starlark transform over event payload

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Workflow Spec
spec.description:
WorkflowSpec defines an approval workflow attached to a state machine
transition (02-core-extended.md §2).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Api Spec
spec.description:
ApiSpec overrides the external API surface (/api/v1/) for a module's entities
(02-core-extended.md §12). It does not affect the UI surface (/_ui/entity/).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Webhook Spec
spec.description:
WebhookSpec defines a verified inbound webhook endpoint
(02-core-extended.md §4).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Integrator Spec
spec.description:
IntegratorSpec bridges two entities/modules that do not know each other
directly (02-core-extended.md §5).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Mockup Spec
spec.description:
MockupSpec defines a simulated connector that implements the same contract
as the real integration (02-core-extended.md §8).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: KindDefinition Spec
spec.description:
KindDefinitionSpec declares a new resource kind (CRD-like extension),
including its schema and handler (platform/03-kind-system.md §2).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Environment Spec
spec.description: EnvironmentSpec defines one deployment target (platform/04-control-plane.md §2).

key_ref.description: KeyRef is the location of the platform signing key (e.g. kms://prod-signing).

mode.description: Mode is the deployment environment mode — dev | prod.

policy.description: Policy names the kind: Policy that applies to this environment.

resource_planes.description: ResourcePlanes lists the resource plane endpoints for this environment.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Policy Spec
spec.description:
PolicySpec defines governance rules evaluated on control-plane decisions
(platform/04-control-plane.md §5). The escape hatch `rego` is compiled into
the same OPA evaluation engine as the structured vocabulary.

blocked.description: Blocked is the policy floor — rules that cannot be configured away.

rego.description: Rego is the escape hatch — full OPA policy body.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Datastore Spec
spec.description: DatastoreSpec is the spec body for kind: Datastore.

access.description: Access controls who (filter) can use this datastore and what

connection.description: Connection holds connection parameters for the backend.

credential_ref.description: CredentialRef is a reference to KMS/Vault for credentials.

serves.description: Serves lists which ctx.* primitives this datastore backs.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Renderer Spec
spec.description:
RendererSpec declares a concrete implementation of a VisualSpecKind
(frontend/03-renderer-kind.md).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: PersistBackend Spec
spec.description:
PersistBackendSpec declares a storage seam implementation
(backend/04-persist-backend.md).

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Page Spec
spec.description:
PageSpec defines a routed screen composing blocks (Frontend §3).
`blocks` and `tabs` are mutually exclusive.

public.description: If true (default), a route is generated for this page. Set false to restrict to embedding only.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Form Spec
spec.description: FormSpec defines an input/edit layout (Frontend §4).

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/form/<name> is auto-generated. Set false for embed-only forms.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Table Spec
spec.description: TableSpec defines a list/browse view (Frontend §5).

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/table/<name> is auto-generated. Set false for embed-only tables.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Dashboard Spec
spec.description: DashboardSpec defines a widget canvas (Frontend §5).

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/dashboard/<name> is auto-generated.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Widget Spec
spec.description: WidgetSpec defines a reusable dashboard widget (Frontend §5).

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/widget/<name> is auto-generated.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Report Spec
spec.description: ReportSpec defines a parameterized tabular report (Frontend §5).

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/report/<name> is auto-generated.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

action.description: server action that commits all steps; if empty, final step plain-creates Entity

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/wizard/<name> is auto-generated.

spec.title: Timeline Spec

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/timeline/<name> is auto-generated.

spec.title: Print Spec
spec.description:
PrintSpec defines a printable document template (Frontend §9).
One format per manifest — declared via `output.format` (Frontend §9).

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/print/<name> is auto-generated.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Theme Spec
spec.description: ThemeSpec defines look & feel as a distributable artifact (Frontend §10).

public.description: If true (default), the theme is active and published in the bundle.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Calendar Spec
spec.description:
CalendarSpec defines a calendar view for date/datetime entity data
(06-page-kinds.md §5). Instance of VisualSpecKind tier: page.

public.description: If true (default), a route /module/calendar/<name> is auto-generated.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: Listing Spec
spec.description:
ListingSpec defines a public catalog page (06-page-kinds.md §10).
Instance of VisualSpecKind tier: page. Similar to table-list but without
Auth-wrap assumptions and without row_actions/bulk_actions.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: ApprovalInbox Spec
spec.description:
ApprovalInboxSpec defines the pending-approval task queue page
(06-page-kinds.md §11). Instance of VisualSpecKind tier: page.
Zero-config: sources are pending Workflow steps eligible for the caller.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: NotificationCenter Spec
spec.description:
NotificationCenterSpec defines the in-app notification page
(06-page-kinds.md §12). Instance of VisualSpecKind tier: page.
Zero-config: lists caller's notifications from forma/notify.

metadata.description: Metadata is common to all Forma resources.

spec.title: VisualSpecKind Spec
spec.description:
VisualSpecKindSpec declares a new view type — a meta-kind that defines the
schema and renderer contract for a family of page/component instances
(frontend/02-visual-spec-kind.md).
